name: b2b-onboarding
title: B2B Onboarding
description: Business applications with document upload, verification and staged approval for B2B Organizations

stages.title: Approval stages
stages.description: Stages each new application goes through, in order. Leave empty for the default: Document review, Compliance check, Final approval. The last stage must be of type APPROVAL, and at most one stage can be VERIFICATION. Applications already submitted keep their stages.

id.title: ID (optional)
id.description: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. Made from the label when empty.
